purpose: Track onboarding support progress per doctor without implying external approvals are practice-controlled.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Plan created after mutual interest; categories not yet scheduled.

shared.label: Shared with doctor
shared.description: Doctor can see capability expectations and category progress.

settling.label: Settling in
settling.description: Core orientation complete; early-week follow-up continues.

complete.label: Onboarding complete
complete.description: Practice support checklist closed; ongoing team collaboration continues as usual.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Onboarding paused by mutual agreement (timing, documents, capacity).

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.description: Plan closed without go-live; retain only as needed for records policy.

access_pending.label: Access pending
access_pending.note: Often depends on IT / identity checks — not a practice approval of clinical credentials.

awaiting_external.label: Awaiting external agency
awaiting_external.note: Practice cannot clear this status; doctor and external agency own the outcome.

practice_ready.label: Practice side ready
practice_ready.note: Practice has supplied what it can; external decision may still be outstanding.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.note: Record the blocker owner (practice vs doctor vs external). Never label an external refusal as a practice rejection of the doctor as a person.

goLiveGate.description: Suggested internal gate before first patient session — not a public promise.

requiredCategoryCompleteness.rule: If awaiting_external, escalate conversation; do not invent a provider number. Billing may be constrained until Services Australia confirms.

hardPrerequisitesOutsideMatrix: Professional indemnity evidence for intended period
Mutual commercial / engagement agreement as applicable

doctorFacingRules: Show can-assist language without guaranteeing outcomes.
When status is awaiting_external, name the agency plainly.
Never display 'approved by WMC' for provider numbers, visas, DPA, or s19AB.
Prefer 'practice side ready' over 'approved' for location documentation support.
